page_title: LD Manager: launchd Manager and Doctor for Mac

sources.entry: LD Manager - Open-source launchd manager that shows every LaunchAgent and LaunchDaemon, explains why a job isn't running, and edits plists losslessly with diffs and backups. summary.name: LD Manager
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source macOS app and command-line tool (ldm) for viewing, diagnosing, and safely editing launchd LaunchAgents and LaunchDaemons.
keywords: see what starts at login mac
use_cases: Find out why a LaunchAgent or LaunchDaemon failed to start
Edit a launchd plist without losing unknown keys
Monitor always-on daemons on a Mac mini server for restart loops
Check which login agents and daemons are running or merely allowed
Script launchd checks using ldm --json and documented exit codes
Replace a cron job with a launchd job
summary.what_it_does: LD Manager lists every launchd job on a Mac, including Apple's own read-only jobs, and joins the plist, loaded state, override, Login Items switch, PID and last exit into one status. Its Doctor checks plists, program paths, permissions, quarantine, log folders and restart loops, and offers a fix for each failure. Schedules and exit codes are explained in plain words, for example exit 78 as EX_CONFIG. Edits can be made as a form, keys or XML, with a diff shown before every save, unknown keys preserved, and backups restorable from Recent Changes. The ldm command line uses the same core and supports --json, --dry-run and documented exit codes.
notable: Open source under the MIT licence, with source on GitHub
Doctor names the cause of failed jobs and offers fixes
Lossless plist editing with diffs and backups
ldm CLI with --json, --dry-run and documented exit codes
caveats: Current download requires macOS 26 or later
Not on the Mac App Store because sandboxed apps cannot drive launchctl
Optional helper must be approved in System Settings to change system jobs without a password
